ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $5.00 no-show fee paid to the driver; no refund. No further action required.
ruling.reasoning:
Type: no-show charge, driver cancelled. NS-0 → NS-1. Testing each NS-1 condition.

(i) Arrival: app event "driver_arrived" at 18:17:45 and GPS at ~18:18 shows the driver at 1.369154,103.847849 ≈ 95 m from the pickup (AMK Hub 1.3688,103.84792) — inside the 200 m radius. Met.

(ii) Free wait: counted from the later of scheduled pickup and arrival. Arrival 18:17:45; the record's threshold-free wait is 5 minutes, so 18:22:45. Cancellation at 18:23:25 — the wait had passed. Met.

(iii) Contact: one in-app message at 18:20:15 ("Still waiting ah, so slow") and one in-app call at 18:19:15 (unanswered). At least 1 message AND 1 call — met. The driver's "so slow" is brusque but not a threat, intimidation or harassment (SAFE-1 not triggered); the rider's complaint contains no safety indicator.

(iv) Continuous presence: GPS shows the driver stationary (0.2–2.0 km/h) at the same point on Ang Mo Kio Ave 3 from 18:18:00 to 18:23:25, no gap. Met.

All four conditions hold, so the $5.00 no-show fee stands (NS-1, §2.1–2.3; precedent DISP-2026-0211 — no-show cancel upheld). The rider's profile carries 1 fraud flag raised for frequent late cancellations, but per TH-3 that only lifts the confidence threshold to 95%, and the four conditions are independently satisfied here, so no refund. Note: the fee arises under the no-show clause, not the rider's own cancellation, so NS-4/NS-9 are not engaged (no_shows_30d is null; no repeat no-show count in the record).

element_findings.element: Driver arrived at pickup within 200 m (NS-1(i))
≥1 in-app message and ≥1 in-app call before cancelling (NS-1(iii))
Driver remained at pickup point throughout (NS-1(iv))
element_findings.reason: Continuous GPS at 0.2–2.0 km/h on Ang Mo Kio Ave 3 from 18:18 to 18:23:25, no gap.
Cancelled for rider no-show per chat 18:23:15 and statement; consistent with the elapsed wait.
No surge applied (multiplier 1.0); actual fare 0. Not engaged.

rejected_claims.reason: The rider's account that the driver 'cancelled just as I was coming down' does not defeat the fee: the systems record shows arrival, a full 5-minute wait, one message and one call before cancellation, and continuous presence at the pickup point (NS-1). The driver's rushing messages were unprofessional but not a safety issue and do not void a valid no-show fee.
